content: Scaler (now Scaler 3, by Plugin Boutique): world's #1 music theory workstation plugin. Features: chord progression generation and editing; key/scale detection (Scaler Detector detects keys/scales/chords from audio or MIDI); voice leading and chord voicing suggestions; melody suggestion tied to chord progression; 100s of instruments; wave terrain synthesis (Carbon Electra 2); Scaler EQ scale-aware EQ (boosts in-key frequencies). DAW integration via VST/AU/AAX. Workstation-style, generation+theory focus, not analysis of user's existing MIDI.
